scope: Repeated CPU-only timings of captured post-sieve states. Repetitions are not independent root samples; no confidence interval or full-range GPU-year estimate is inferred.
accounting: Single-worker CPU and wall times include state decoding, validation, allocation, all bucket construction and exact verification. Resident tables are built separately. Fixture loading, GPU filtering/transfers, oracle comparisons and wide rechecks are excluded. Best configurations are descriptive selections from this fixture, not established population winners.

record.fixture_scope: First up to 262144 exact states from the first selected GPU export during the first 32-root warmup. This is a conditional launch/class fixture, not an independent or representative sample of the full N72 survivor population.
record.source_hash_scope: Files present at execution; binary_sha256 identifies the executable.

arguments.fixture_scope: First up to 262144 exact states from the first selected GPU export during the first 32-root warmup. This is a conditional launch/class fixture, not an independent or representative sample of the full N72 survivor population.

record.statistics_scope: Repeated timings on one fixed conditional fixture; no root-sampling inference.

config.excluded_scope: fixture loading, table construction, correctness comparisons, wide rechecks, GPU screening and transfer
config.grouping: initial_group_table shares only the first row; regrouped_table buckets unfinished states after every transition
config.input_fingerprint_note: FNV is an identity aid, not a cryptographic digest; capture metadata records provenance
config.order: rotated by 13 positions per repetition, with alternate repetitions reversed
config.timed_scope: decode and validate states, allocations, all sorting and exact verification; resident tables prebuilt
